content.wiring: Each of the six levers (L1-L3 in room A, L4-L6 in room B) is secretly wired to some of the four gates G1-G4. Pulling a lever flips every gate it is wired to (open <-> closed).
content.rule: A gate is open exactly when an ODD number of the levers wired to it are ON. All levers start OFF.
content.view: G1 and G2 are in room A, G3 and G4 in room B. You can only watch the gates in your own room.
content.cooldown: After a pull, a lever needs 3 steps before it can be pulled again (field ready_at_step).

hints: Both agents must stand in the goal_zone 'exit' (below both rooms) at the same time.

briefings.A:
You are in room A (left) with levers L1-L3 and gates G1, G2 (G2 lies beyond G1). Agent B is in room B (right) with L4-L6 and gates G3, G4. A wall separates the rooms. Read wiring_note_A. Object guide: lever with "cooldown": after a pull it cannot be pulled again until step 'ready_at_step'. goal_zone: a rectangle centred on (x, y) with the given width/height.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
